artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.artist: H. G. Watkins, after George Elgar Hicks
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two human figures and a ghostly presence. The scene shows the figures sitting on the ground in a peaceful setting with grass. A large ghostly figure with a wide cloak hovers overhead, giving an ominous aura. The background is minimalist with light cloud details. The image includes an inscription that reads "COMPOSITIONS FROM CAMPBELL'S GERTRUDE OF WYOMING BY G. E. HICKS" at the top and a mention of "ART-UNION OF LONDON MDCCCXLVI" at the bottom. The drawing is done in a line style, emphasizing contours and outlines for depth and dimension.

artworks.title: He for His Bleeding Country Prays to Heaven
artworks.artist: H. G. Watkins, after George Elgar Hicks
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with multiple figures gathered in a room. The drawing captures a group of people standing and sitting within a space. One individual dressed in European-style clothing stands in the center, while others are gathered around, adorned in headdresses and holding spears. The figures are drawn with fine, precise lines, emphasizing outlines and forms rather than shading. The setting appears to be an interior space, with vertical and horizontal lines suggesting walls and a ceiling. The figures in the scene are depicted in a calm, composed manner.

artworks.title: Saint Germain, L'Auxerrois
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1932)
artworks.description: This artwork shows a street-level view of an architectural structure, potentially a cathedral, with a detailed tower at the center. Scaffolding is visible on parts of the building, suggesting construction or renovation. The brushstrokes are precise, capturing the intricate details of the Gothic architecture. The color scheme is monochrome, enhancing the textures and shadows. Figures in period attire walk along a shadowed square. Trees frame the right side, adding depth. The sky is lightly sketched in the background.

artworks.title: The Steamer Yellow-stone
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black with hand-coloring on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1960)
artworks.description: The image depicts a river scene from an elevated point of view. The horizon is visible in the background, where the river meets a line of trees and hills. A steamship named "THE STEAMER YELLOW-STONE" is sailing across the water towards the right side of the image, emitting dark smoke from its chimneys against the light sky. Near the shore, figures are pulling something from the water onto the shore, with one person standing next to a small boat. The painting features delicate brushstrokes capturing the water's motion and the details of the ship and figures. The color palette includes muted earth tones, deep greens for foliage, and blues and grays for the sky and river, creating a tranquil yet dynamic visual impact.

artworks.title: The Lovely Gertrude, Safe from Present Harm
artworks.artist: Edward Webb, after George Elgar Hicks
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a group of individuals on a hillside. The scene includes European settlers and Native American figures, alongside simple structures and a distant landscape. The figures are outlined minimally, focusing on their forms rather than details. One figure holds a shield and spear, while another is draped in a cloak, looking forward. The composition implies interaction or observation, with figures facing different directions. The drawing has a balanced symmetry, highlighting the central figures with the landscape in the background.

artworks.title: Delightful Wyoming!
artworks.artist: Edward Webb, after George Elgar Hicks
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a pastoral landscape with figures and animals. The left side shows an older man seated with a dog, playing a pipe. In the center, four figures are dancing. On the right, a younger figure is seated, playing a pipe with another dog. In the background, there are grazing animals and trees. The artwork features light, delicate line work emphasizing flow and rhythm.

artworks.title: Close He Had Come...
artworks.artist: Edward Webb, after George Elgar Hicks
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals and a horse in an outdoor setting. The first person, an adult male, is standing beside the horse. He wears a hat that casts a shadow over his eyes, a tailored jacket, knee-length trousers, and boots, and holds the horse's reins. The second individual is seated on the ground, leaning against a tree or bush, with a book on her lap. She has long, wavy hair adorned with flowers and wears a flowing gown with long sleeves. The background features trees, shrubs, and a waterfall cascading down a cliffside into a body of water.

artworks.title: He Bids Me Dry the Last...
artworks.artist: Edward Webb, after George Elgar Hicks
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing with two figures in the foreground. The first figure is a man in a dynamic pose, leaning forward, covering his face with his right arm, and holding a spear in his left hand. He is adorned with a necklace, feathered headpiece, loincloth, and appears muscular. The second figure is lying face down, with only the upper body visible. Sparse vegetation surrounds them, including a tree and shrubs. In the background, there is a building with a pitched roof and a group of people.

artworks.title: Ménélas vainqueur
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image shows a victorious warrior with a drawn sword, accompanied by another figure. In the background, there are billowing smoke clouds and faint outlines of structures, with fallen bodies and debris on the ground. The drawing has a dramatic and somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: Boats at Peel—Isle of Man
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor with sailboats docked alongside the water's edge. One boat is closer to us, with its mast cutting across the sky. The horizon aligns with the rooftops and buildings of the port town in the background. Detailed black lines and crosshatched marks depict the boats and buildings. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray on a cream base. Shadows and rigging lines add dynamism to the scene.

artworks.title: Rag Pickers, Quartier Mouffetard, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1927)
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed etching of an interior scene with two figures. One figure is seated on the left side, while the other figure stands on the right side. Both figures are shown from head to toe. The seated figure has long hair and leans slightly forward, while the standing figure wears a wide-brimmed hat and a long coat or cloak. A table with objects is placed between the figures. The room is depicted with textured surfaces, including fabric or tapestry hanging on the walls. The background features textured walls and ceiling beams, creating a rustic interior setting. The etching is intricate, with detailed line work that adds depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Becquet
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an artwork of a man seated, holding a musical instrument. He has facial features including a mustache and thick, curly hair. He is wearing a coat over a shirt with a scarf and is positioned against a lightly sketched background.

artworks.title: Free Trade Wharf
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with ships, buildings, and a person in a boat.

artworks.title: Fumette
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a seated woman. She has long, wavy hair and is wearing a dark dress with a lighter skirt. She sits with her arms on her knees and looks forward with wide eyes and a neutral expression. The background is plain with a textured quality.

artworks.title: Billingsgate
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bustling port scene with various sailboats docked, people on the quay and boats, and urban structures in the background. The detailed etching technique creates a monochromatic image using shades of sepia. The scene is framed with tall ship masts at the horizon. The composition includes a range of activities and structures, depicted with varying line density for contrast.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Douze Eaux Fortes d'après Nature"
artworks.medium: etching in black on blue wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a group of figures surrounding a central seated figure wearing a wide-brimmed hat. The drawing includes sketched figures engaged with the individual who is seated. The style is loose and sketchy, with handwritten inscriptions and signatures present at the top and bottom of the work. The top text reads "James Whistler" and "Douze Eaux Fortes", while the bottom notes "Mon viel Ami, Seymour Haden". The scene captures a moment of interaction with a sense of spontaneity and unfinished detailing.

artworks.title: The Camp
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene by a body of water. The composition features lines depicting a natural landscape, with a person on the left side. The drawing uses a monochromatic color palette to suggest the beauty of nature. The surrounding trees and reflections in the water create a textured atmosphere. The composition conveys a sense of calm, capturing a moment in nature.

artworks.title: Le retour d'Ulysse
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a man playing a wind instrument as he walks. He is barefoot and wearing draped clothing - possibly a tunic or robe. His head is slightly bowed, and he carries a sack over his shoulder. Walking alongside him is a dog, attached to a leash, with its gaze focused forward. The sculpture is carved into a stone-like slab, predominantly grayscale in color. The scene is presented in relief, capturing a moment of movement as the subjects proceed on their journey.

artworks.title: The Forge
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with multiple figures in a dimly lit interior setting. In the center, a man stands in a semi-profile position with his hand on his hip, facing another figure who is partially visible to the left. To the right of him, two men stand close together, wearing wide-brimmed hats and facial hair. In the foreground, there's an anvil and a hammer, indicating a workshop, possibly a smithy. In the background on the right, two women are seated and huddled, draped in shawls or long garments. Next to them, a small child stands holding a stick. Hanging from the ceiling are long tools or pieces of metal. The sketch depicts a slice of everyday life from the period in a rough yet detailed style.

artworks.title: The Little Putney, No. 1
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverscape with a bridge, buildings, and a church reflected in the water. The horizon is defined by the bridge, and various structures are visible beyond it. The artwork has a monochrome color palette, with subtle variations of beige and light brown against darker ink lines.

artworks.title: Fumette
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting with their knees drawn up and arms resting on them. The individual has long, wavy hair and a neutral facial expression. They are dressed in a long, flowing garment with no visible jewelry. The background is textured and the focus is on the person in the drawing.

artworks.title: Hurlingham
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with sailboats on the water. The horizon shows trees and buildings. The brushwork or etching technique is detailed, highlighting the sailboats and their reflections in the water. The color palette is predominantly black, gray, and pale tones. The buildings and trees in the distance blend harmoniously with the still water and boats.

artworks.title: Une rencontre de jouyeauz augures
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures dressed in ancient-style garments, engaging in an interaction. The scene depicts two figures in togas, one with hands behind his back and the other with hands at his sides. Both figures have exaggerated facial expressions. The background features simple structures and birds in the sky. The style is reminiscent of traditional lithographs with strong contrasts and sketch-like quality. French text below the image suggests a satirical context.

artworks.title: La Marchande de Moutarde
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two people in a doorway or interior space. One person is on the left, facing inward, while the second person is on the right, slightly leaning forward and extending their hands. The person on the left has their hair tied back and is dressed in a long garment. The other person also has their hair tied back and wears a long-sleeved dress. The space includes shelves with containers and pottery. The doorway is framed by textured stone or brick.
